card.name: Geology of strata and deposits
card.fires_on: Modifier words just before an expected geology noun such as deposits, formations, or strata, in passages on fossils, chalk and sediment. Examples are European, American, extensive, underlying and polar.

modes.label: Regional adjectives
modes.description: Place adjectives before formations or deposits in old paleontology prose.
modes.example: so it is, according to Lyell, with the European and North<< American>> tertiary deposits.

modes.label: Other modifiers in rock descriptions
modes.description: Words like extensive, underlying or polar that sit before deposits, ice or rock terms.
